SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT target AS BUYER , KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO , KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ , KEY_3 AS REVISION , KEY_4 AS MSDS_NO FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'MSDS' AND TARGET IN (SELECT TEXT4 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRSYSE0001' AND TYPE = 'PLNT') AND KEY_9 = '2' ORDER BY TARGET,KEY_1,KEY_2,KEY_3
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT MSDS.MSDS_NO AS ITEM_NO , MSDS.FILE_NO , ATCH.SRC_FILE_NAME , ATCH.DES_FILE_NAME , '$G_RS.BUYER$'||'/'|| '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$'||'/'|| '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AS KEP_MNG , '01' AS STATUS FROM KEP.KEPMSDSDT MSDS, KEP.ICOMATCH ATCH WHERE MSDS.MSDS_NO= '$G_RS.MSDS_NO$' AND MSDS.STATUS = 'C' AND MSDS.IMAGE_KEY = ATCH.DOC_NO ORDER BY MSDS.MSDS_NO, MSDS.FILE_NO
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET key_9 = '3' , key_10 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE doc_name = 'MSDS' and target = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND key_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND key_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND key_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.MSDS_NO$' AND KEY_9 = '2'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET key_9 = 'E' , key_10 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE doc_name = 'MSDS' and target = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND key_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND key_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND key_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.MSDS_NO$' AND KEY_9 = '2'
